commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Flag goes up against Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+4' The ball possession at the moment is 53:47.
90+1' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Paul Nebel (Mainz) for his blatant foul.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
89' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
88' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. RB Leipzig will take a corner kick.
87' Substitution. Gabriel Vidovic (Mainz) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Anthony Caci walks off.
87' Substitution. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) on for Maxim Leitsch.
87' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
84' Problems for Marco Rose as Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Yussuf Poulsen replaces him.
84' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
84' Felix Zwayer blows for a foul after Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
83' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
80' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

80' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Peter Gulacsi to dive and make a save. Mainz force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
79' Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
79' Danny da Costa (Mainz) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
77' Danny da Costa (Mainz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
77' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Here comes a substitution. Nelson Weiper (Mainz) is brought on as a substitute for Jae-Sung Lee.
74' That will be all from Antonio Nusa who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
74' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Benjamin Sesko will be replaced by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig).
74' Here comes a substitution. Arthur Vermeeren is given a rest as he is replaced by Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig).

73' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Robin Zentner pulls off a comfortable save.
72' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
69' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
68' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

68' Anthony Caci (Mainz) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Peter Gulacsi thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Mainz get a corner.
66' Danny da Costa (Mainz) makes a strong challenge and Felix Zwayer blows for a foul.
63' Mainz are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
61' Mainz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' Mainz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
61' The resulting set piece from Mainz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
60' Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
59' Here is a change. Armindo Sieb is going off and Bo Henriksen gives the last tactical orders to Paul Nebel (Mainz).
59' Danny da Costa (Mainz) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Felix Zwayer blows for a foul.
56' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Amadou Haidara as he is replaced by Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig).
56' Danny da Costa (Mainz) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
53' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
51' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
50' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle. Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) commits a foul after dangerous play.
47' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
47' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to RB Leipzig.
46' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
43' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
41' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
41' Mainz keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
37' 0 - 2 Goal! Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 0:2.

37' It's unbelievable, Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) blows a huge opportunity! He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific daisy-cutter from point blank range. His first-time effort is directed towards the middle of the target, but Robin Zentner reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
37' Now RB Leipzig have a corner.
34' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
32' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
32' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Felix Zwayer no option but to blow his whistle.
30' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
29' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
28' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
28' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
27' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
26' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
26' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
25' Moritz Jenz (Mainz) commits a rough challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul.
24' The game is interrupted now, Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
24' Dangerous play by Moritz Jenz (Mainz). Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul.

20' 0 - 1 Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Robin Zentner is just a bystander as the ball flies low into the middle of the goal. The score is 0:1.
17' The RB Leipzig players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
16' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
14' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

14' RB Leipzig are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
11' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
8' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Felix Zwayer signals.
7' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
6' Rough tackle by Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Robin Zentner displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
3' The ball is cleared after Armindo Sieb (Mainz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
